title: 相机控制问题
description: 相机无法旋转、不跟随飞船或不断锁定回准星，导致视角控制困难。
evidence: Can't rotate the player camera, can rotate the ship camera!
constant issue with the camera moving and not sticking to the ship despite my settings being set to follow ship
Especially as it kept locking the camera back to the crosshairs.

evidence_items.quote: Can't rotate the player camera, can rotate the ship camera!
evidence_items.description: 玩家视角无法旋转，只能随飞船朝向旋转
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不能旋转玩家视角，却能旋转飞船视角！

evidence_items.quote: constant issue with the camera moving and not sticking to the ship despite my settings being set to follow ship
evidence_items.description: 相机不跟随飞船，尽管设置已设为跟随
evidence_items.quote_zh: 镜头不断移动，尽管我的设置已设为跟随飞船，却始终不固定在飞船上

evidence_items.quote: Especially as it kept locking the camera back to the crosshairs.
evidence_items.quote_zh: 尤其是因为它总是把镜头锁回准星。
